yearStability.note: All 4 yearly buckets positive. 2026 (n=17) is currently the weakest (PF 1.081, WR 41.18%, +0.0489R). Uneven strength is a monitoring caveat, not a justification to filter by year; V1 stays frozen rather than re-optimized on the same sample.

consensusScore.note: SAME-SAMPLE diagnostic. Every matched trade happened to be consensus +4; the >= +3 rule never bound in this cohort. This is historical metadata, NOT justification to change the rule.

closeExtreme.note: SAME-SAMPLE diagnostic. top-25% / top-15% / top-10% cohorts overlap by construction. NOT a filter, threshold, or V2.
